moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-data-story-budget-bloom, written here): Donut r 50, 18 px stroke on a grid-colour track, from 12 o'clock clockwise. Arcs sweep in order, easeInOut: 50 % (accent) 350-1150 ms, 30 % (second colour) 1250-1750, 20 % (yellow) 1850-2200; a 2 px background-colour separator at each start. Each value label pops back.out at r + 26 px from its arc's end - 50 to + 250 ms. Centre total counts with the arcs to 100, pops 1 -> 1.12 -> 1 over 2200-2500. Exit 3550-3900 ease-in: shrink to 0.94 + fade. Params: parts (50 / 30 / 20) · radius (50 px) · width (18 px).
